components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a screen: Create room, Join, Start.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 18px/1.35 ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: var(--bg, #060b1a); background: var(--cyan, #2ee6e6); border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 64px; min-width: 64px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(46,230,230,.45); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #ffd23f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(1.2); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .35; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action beside a primary one: Join by code, Pause, End.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font: 18px/1.35 ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: var(--cyan, #2ee6e6); background: transparent; border: 2px solid var(--cyan, #2ee6e6); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 64px; min-width: 64px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(46,230,230,.12); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #ffd23f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Input

components.name: Rules Card
components.description: The three-line rules shown on the landing page, the lobby and the phone wait screen.
components.html:
1. Grab loot, bring it home. First to 600 wins.
  2. Shoot ships to make them drop their loot.
  3. Own rings and stations. They pay you over time.
◯ joystick (left thumb) · FIRE / BOOST / BUILD (right thumb)
components.css: .ds-rules { font: 18px/1.35 ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: var(--fg, #d8f3ff); background: #0a1430; border: 2px solid var(--cyan, #2ee6e6); border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px 20px; max-width: 560px; } .ds-rules ol { margin: 0; padding-left: 1.4em; } .ds-rules li { margin: .35em 0; } .ds-rules b { color: var(--gold, #ffd23f); } .ds-rules-ctl { color: var(--dim, #6c88a8); margin-top: 10px; font-size: .85em; }

components.name: Thumb Buttons
components.description: Phone action cluster: BUILD and BOOST circles beside the big FIRE button.
components.css: .ds-thumbs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 76px 112px; grid-template-rows: 76px 76px; gap: 10px; padding: 12px; background: #0b1330; } .ds-thumb { font: bold 13px ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: #fff; width: 76px; height: 76px; border-radius: 50%; padding: 0; background: rgba(18,40,74,.85); border: 2px solid var(--cyan, #2ee6e6); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(46,230,230,.25); text-shadow: 0 1px 2px #000; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .08s, filter .08s; } .ds-thumb:active { filter: brightness(1.5); transform: scale(.95); } .ds-thumb:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #ffd23f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-build { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; background: rgba(61,220,151,.85); } .ds-boost { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; background: conic-gradient(rgba(46,230,230,.7) 65%, rgba(18,40,74,.85) 0); } .ds-fire { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / 3; align-self: end; width: 112px; height: 112px; font-size: 18px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%, #ff7a93, #c22c4b); border-color: #ffb3c1; box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255,77,109,.45); }

components.name: Perk Card
components.description: One of the two level-up choices on the phone.
components.css: .ds-perk { font: 13px/1.35 ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: var(--fg, #d8f3ff); width: 150px; min-height: 92px; padding: 12px; text-align: left; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1d2f60, #0b1430); border: 2px solid var(--gold, #ffd23f); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(255,210,63,.35); cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow .15s; } .ds-perk b { display: block; font-size: 16px; color: var(--gold, #ffd23f); margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-perk:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(255,210,63,.6); } .ds-perk:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #2ee6e6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Player Row
components.description: Scanner score row: colour chip with glyph, name, score and level, and a race bar in the player's colour.
components.css: .ds-prow { font: 20px ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: var(--fg, #d8f3ff); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 340px; background: var(--bg, #060b1a); padding: 8px; } .ds-chip { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 8px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: bold; color: var(--bg, #060b1a); background: #ff4d6d; } .ds-score { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-bar { grid-column: 2 / 4; height: 6px; background: #12284a; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-bar i { display: block; height: 100%; width: 70%; border-radius: 3px; background: #ff4d6d; }

components.css: .ds-hud { font: 14px ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: var(--fg, #d8f3ff); width: 196px; display: grid; gap: 5px; padding: 7px 9px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(14,28,64,.86), rgba(6,11,26,.62)); border: 1px solid rgba(46,230,230,.32); border-radius: 3px 12px 3px 3px; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px #000; } .ds-mrow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px 1fr 54px; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-mrow b { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .1em; color: var(--dim, #6c88a8); } .ds-mrow span { font-size: 12px; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-trk { position: relative; height: 10px; background: rgba(18,40,74,.95); border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-trk i { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; transition: width .3s ease-out; } .ds-hull i { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #22a872, #3ddc97); } .ds-hold i { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #2fb895, #7fffd4); box-shadow: 0 0 6px #7fffd4; } .ds-hold::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent calc(100% - 2px), rgba(6,11,26,.95) 0) 0 0 / 10% 100%; } .ds-lv { font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; color: var(--gold, #ffd23f); }

components.name: Objective Chip
components.description: Top-centre phone chip echoing the 3D arrow: gold for HOME, aquamarine for LOOT.
components.css: .ds-obj { font: bold 15px ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: var(--gold, #ffd23f); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px 0 6px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(14,28,64,.86), rgba(6,11,26,.62)); border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 3px 12px 3px 3px; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px #000; } .ds-obj svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: currentColor; stroke: var(--bg, #060b1a); stroke-width: 1.5; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 3px currentColor); } .ds-obj span { color: var(--fg, #d8f3ff); font-weight: normal; font-size: 13px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
Dark navy space where the only light comes from things worth stealing. Loot crystals, player trim, bolts and objectives glow; everything else sits back in the dark. The look is low-poly and flat-shaded on the phone, and a flat vector radar on the Scanner, held together by one monospace typeface and one cyan instrument line that runs through both.

Every colour has a job. Gold means home and score, aquamarine means loot, cyan is the instrument itself, red is danger, and the twelve player colours mean ownership. The interface reads like glowing instruments on a cockpit console: translucent navy panels with thin cyan strokes, light emitted rather than cast, no drop shadows. Density is low on the Scanner (it must read from across a room) and tight on the phone HUD, which hugs the corners so the 3D view stays clear.

Everything is drawn in code. 3D models are Three.js primitives, icons are inline SVG, the QR is generated, the Scanner is Canvas 2D.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy ground (#060b1a) everywhere: page, scene background, Scanner canvas.
Glow instead of shadow: coloured `box-shadow` halos, `drop-shadow` on icons, additive 3D sprites.
One monospace family for every surface and size.
Fixed colour roles shared by HTML, Canvas and 3D.
Every player colour travels with its letter glyph.

rules.name: The Colour Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Gold is home and score, aquamarine is loot, cyan is the instrument, red is danger, and player colours are ownership. A role colour is never used as decoration.

rules.name: The Glyph Partner Rule
rules.body: A player colour never appears alone: every HQ, station, ping, chip and score row carries the owner's letter glyph. Players A, C, D and G share hues with Alarm Red, Bank Gold, Hull Green and Radar Cyan, so the glyph is what tells ownership apart from a system cue.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: Every surface uses the system monospace stack. Never add a second family.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any number that changes during play (hull, hold, distance, score race) uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so it doesn't jitter.

rules.name: The Glow Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Things emit light in their own colour; they do not cast shadows. Add a halo, never a drop shadow.

dos: Do pair every player colour with its letter glyph (The Glyph Partner Rule).
Do keep each role colour to its job: gold for home and score, aquamarine for loot, cyan for the instrument, red for danger.
Do lift all HUD text over the 3D view with `text-shadow: 0 1px 3px #000`.
Do keep thumb targets at least 64px (the shipped sizes are 76px and 112px).
Do use tabular figures for any number that changes during play.
Do keep the phone HUD in the corners and the left half clear for the joystick.
Do keep Scanner sidebar text at 17px or larger so it reads from across the room.
donts: Don't add drop shadows for elevation; use a glow in the element's own colour (The Glow Not Shadow Rule).
Don't render the Scanner in 3D; it is a flat Canvas 2D radar.
Don't use gold, aquamarine or red decoratively; a player would read it as an objective, loot or damage.
